messages:
claire: Quick onboarding/help request. While reviewing a newcomer PR for ruby-sampleapp I noticed the SDK behaves differently from node/go on auth retry semantics. New contributor added a global retry middleware and it retries for non-idempotent streaming chat requests, which caused double outputs in integration tests. Anyone have a quick stance on parity?

claire: Minimal repro attached in PR: runs chat streaming and the middleware retries on 502/429 regardless of stream flag.

diego: We intentionally avoided body retries in Ruby historically to prevent double-delivery for streams. Go has more nuanced behavior (retries for idempotent ops only). Where is the middleware applied (app-wide or per-client)?

claire: It's inserted in sampleapp/app.rb as a top-level middleware so it affects all endpoints.

marta: That's dangerous for streaming endpoints. Two quick options: 1) scope middleware to non-streaming endpoints, 2) have middleware check for a header like `x-redwood-stream: 1` and skip. Also add explicit tests to assert middleware is a no-op for streams.

claire: I like the header guard approach because its less invasive for sampleapp authors. For SDK parity we should document default: "no automatic body retries for streaming; opt-in via RB_RETRY_MODE=permissive".

diego: Agree. Also flag for maintainers: if adding retries, consider a per-operation policy (embeddings/chat-nonstream/rerank) not global.

ci-bot: CI note: ruby-sampleapp PR #137 lint failed (rubocop) and integration hung on streaming test - increased timeout to 60s temporarily.

marta: I'll push a small update to the PR: add a guard in middleware and a unit test that stubs a streaming endpoint and ensures no retry attempts are made. Also update docs.

claire: Thanks! Can we also add a short snippet in CONTRIBUTING that warns new contributors about middleware scope when touching SDK behavior? Most folks copy middleware from examples and don't realize stream implications.

ci-bot: github/actions - ruby-sampleapp CI #1217 triggered by marta - jobs: unit, integration, lint

diego: One more DX note: sampleapp README references `bundle exec bin/sampleapp` which spawns a binstub; ensure examples explicitly recommend token refresh modes (per-request for quickstart) so new devs don't hit stale token forks.

marta: Good call, I'll add `RB_TOKEN_REFRESH_MODE=per_request` to the quickstart command and a line about not shipping that in prod.

claire: Perfect. After tests pass I'll merge and cut a minor patch to the sampleapp repo. Appreciate the fast turnaround :thumbsup:
